author: Praxis I
title: Idea 3 — WINSOR q=0.01: Per-Batch HVG Winsorization + ComBat → PCA50 → kNN15
abstract: Per-batch, per-gene winsorization of HVGs at [1%, 99%] prior to ComBat to reduce heavy-tail artifacts; then ComBat → PCA(50) → kNN(15, cosine). Goal: stabilize distances and batch estimates with minimal loss of biological extremes.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
from scipy import sparse as sp

def _ensure_dense(X):
    return X.A if sp.issparse(X) else X

def _winsor_inplace(Xd, batches, hv_mask, q=0.01):
    batches = np.asarray(batches)
    hv_idx = np.where(hv_mask)[0]
    for b in np.unique(batches):
        idx = np.where(batches == b)[0]
        if idx.size == 0:
            continue
        Xb = Xd[idx[:, None], hv_idx]
        lo = np.quantile(Xb, q, axis=0)
        hi = np.quantile(Xb, 1.0 - q, axis=0)
        Xb = np.minimum(np.maximum(Xb, lo), hi)
        Xd[idx[:, None], hv_idx] = Xb

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    n_pcs = 50
    n_neighbors = 15
    metric = 'cosine'
    assert 'batch' in adata.obs.columns and 'feature_name' in adata.var.columns

    # Normalize/log1p
    if 'counts' in adata.layers:
        adata.X = adata.layers['counts'].copy()
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata)

    # HVGs (batch-aware)
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, flavor='seurat_v3', batch_key='batch', n_top_genes=2000, inplace=True)
    hv = adata.var['highly_variable'].to_numpy()
    batches = np.asarray(adata.obs['batch'].astype('category').values)

    # Winsorize HVGs per batch at [1%, 99%] (dense)
    Xd = _ensure_dense(adata.X)
    _winsor_inplace(Xd, batches=batches, hv_mask=hv, q=0.01)
    adata.X = Xd

    # ComBat on dense
    sc.pp.combat(adata, key='batch')

    # PCA on HVGs and kNN graph
    sc.pp.pca(adata, n_comps=n_pcs, use_highly_variable=True, svd_solver='arpack', random_state=0)
    adata.obsm['X_emb'] = adata.obsm['X_pca']
    sc.pp.neighbors(adata, use_rep='X_emb', n_neighbors=n_neighbors, metric=metric)
    return adata
